description.value: Established in 1983, Yoka's Coffee is a small, independent coffee roaster and retailer in Victoria's North Park neighbourhood, roasting all beans on-site in a mid-1930s Royal roaster. The shop stocks more than twenty single-sourced and blended coffees—including fair-trade and certified organic options—alongside loose tea, chocolate, and local honey. It is a cash-only shop with an old-world, non-corporate character, about a 15-minute walk from Old Town Victoria.
